intro: Winterfall Village is a sprawling furbolg encampment nestled in the snowdrifts of eastern Winterspring, just east of Everlook. Once peaceful kin to the other ursine tribes of Kalimdor, the Winterfall furbolgs living here have descended into madness and violent corruption under the rule of High Chief Winterfall.

p: Sprawled across the terraced snowbanks east of the goblin trading post Everlook, Winterfall Village serves as the primary bastion of the Winterfall furbolgs in Winterspring. Like their cousins scattered across northern Kalimdor, these bear-folk were warped and driven mad by the lingering foulness of the Burning Legion's invasion. Led by High Chief Winterfall from a secluded cavern atop the settlement's highest tier, the tribe has abandoned its ancestral ways. Instead of communing peacefully with the wild spirits of the snow, the enraged furbolgs now aggressively assault travelers, patrol the mountain passes, and threaten any who come near their frost-bitten home.
